trail.name: Surprise and Amphitheater Lakes
trail.coordinateNote: Official NPS Lupine Meadows Trailhead marker; 4.6 m from reviewed route/access geometry. This is an area forecast reference, not navigation or uniform conditions along the route.
trail.planningNote: Long, steep mountain hike: check current conditions with a backcountry ranger. Snow travel may require specialist skills and equipment. The trailhead-area forecast does not represent the higher route. TrailPack covers day-hike packing, not climbing or overnight equipment.

additionalSources.note: Official NPS activity-map configuration used to identify the named route corridor; alternate access routes and branches are not silently substituted.

comparison.note: Reviewed NPS-origin USGS segments, with clipped sections and return legs counted explicitly, total 9.913 mi (1.2% versus NPS). This is route-corridor evidence, not a navigation track.

photo.alt: An alpine lake sits beneath rocky mountain peaks.
photo.permissionNote: Reviewed the official NPS page and its NPS photographer credit; no third-party restriction is displayed. Retain attribution and source; no endorsement is implied. Original sharpness reviewed without upscaling.
